context.content_translation:
灯上的定时器设计用于-------关闭它，以减少能源消耗。
A. automatic
B. automatically
C. automated
D. automate

items.question: The timer on the lamp is designed to turn it off ------- to reduce energy use.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“automatically”代入题干后为“The timer on the lamp is designed to turn it off automatically to reduce energy use.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（automatically）。
